content.text: Incia amembali haakimu mobhotukiakana parakara i tanga-tangana manga "aulataʼala,"
"Sakawana naepia ingkomiu bheuala kambotu tee cara inda moʼadili
tee uewaaka manga mia madhaki? Sela
Ewaakamea o hakuna mia momisikini tee ana maelu,
dhawuakea kaʼadili to mia motopisaki tee mia inda mokokadhaangia.
Pasalaamatia o mia momisikini tee mia monarakaa,
rambasakea manga incia minaaka i limana mia madhaki."
Ingkomiu inda umataua, ingkomiu uka inda umaʼanaia,
tee bhari-bharikomiu sii o anana Momalangana;
moomini mboo sumai, ingkomiu bheumate mboomo maanusia,
tee mboomo manga kaogesa, ingkomiu uka bheumate."
E Aulataʼala, kakaromo, adilia o dunia sii;
roonamo bhari-bharia lipu satotuuna o pewauamu.

footnotes.text: aulataʼala: Pogau Ibranina "elohim" kananeana akomaʼana dewa atawa Kawasana Opu, maka i nuncana aeati incia sii tee 82:6amembali akomaʼana manga malaaʼekati modorohaka i Aulataʼala, siitumo manga seetani. Bhanguna mboo manga "aulataʼala" sumai atohakimi i sidangina sorogaa incia sii.
Sela: Aipomo tandana to aunto wakutuuna lagu sumai atolaguaka, atawa o tanda to ahanda apekaogea o suarana, atawa onina gambusuna. Amembali uka to tanda to morangoa.
